deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next packaging-config housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference for this doc-slim wave.
description: Line counts of packaging-config doc surfaces. spec.md peaked at 588 lines when it carried 17 historical `## Plugin patch/minor vX.Y.Z` release-note sections (v0.5.0 -> v0.8.0). Per coding-rules and the principle that history belongs in docs/CHANGELOG.md never in the doc surface, those 17 release-note sections were removed from spec.md and folded into docs/CHANGELOG.md, re-anchoring spec.md to 305 lines (living spec only: Purpose, paths, public surface, current behavior, invariants; every load-bearing token preserved verbatim). The #355 version-monotonicity-on-content-change invariant then added a 9-line bullet to the invariants list, re-anchoring spec.md to 314 lines. The RABBIT_GATE release-hygiene-skip invariant then added a 13-line bullet to the invariants list, re-anchoring spec.md to 327 lines. Registering the /auto-maintainer:clobber control skill + clobber.py lib in build_plugin then expanded the Shipped-control-skills bullet with the new-control-skill registration rule (lib map + curated _COMMAND_DESCRIPTIONS entry, count/enumeration tests advanced in lockstep), adding 7 lines and re-anchoring spec.md to 334 lines. Shipping RECONCILE + reject-label exclusion in the default-config (Wave-2) then added the Shipped-default-config-wiring section, re-anchoring spec.md to 350 lines. Re-authoring that section for the neutral pull-all issue_filter default (schema 2.9.0, interval 10, release v0.26.0) then added 3 lines, re-anchoring spec.md to 353 lines. This baseline tracks that current spec.md line count so the no-growth gate stays consistent. The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are no LARGER than these baselines (a reduced|no-op verdict), spec.md is not larger, and the load-bearing tokens survived the slim.
